description: Second, held-out evaluation set written on 2026-11-20 from the body text (results, methods, discussion, conclusion) of the 18 articles in data/eval.sqlite3, not from their abstracts (except the three review articles without such sections), in different or everyday wording, with relevant articles chosen by reading the text and no search run while writing. Held out: use it only to confirm decisions, never to tune settings. All entries need the owner's review.

questions.question: In a European study of people over 75 with diabetes, how did kidney function differ between those taking metformin and those not taking it?
questions.note: Results: eGFR 56.3 vs 44.8 mL/min/1.73 m² in metformin users vs non-users.

questions.question: Did older people with diabetes who took metformin keep their grip strength better over two years?
questions.note: Conclusion: no significant effects on physical performance or handgrip strength (answer is no).

questions.question: How common were heart attacks in people with diabetes and bowel inflammation who received incretin-based injections, compared with similar patients who did not?
questions.note: Results: myocardial infarction 4.0% vs 8.2%.

questions.question: Over a 40-year model, how many extra quality-adjusted life years did a once-weekly injectable diabetes drug developed in China give compared with a daily tablet?
questions.note: Results: 1.9476 additional QALYs for loxenatide vs sitagliptin.

questions.question: According to genetic studies, which diabetes drug classes might raise the risk of heart failure?
questions.note: Results: thiazolidinediones increased heart failure risk (OR 1.12).

questions.question: How might faulty clean-up of damaged mitochondria contribute to blood vessel injury in the childhood illness that inflames the coronary arteries?
questions.note: Discussion: defective mitophagy and lysosomal dysfunction drive inflammation via NLRP3/cGAS-STING in Kawasaki disease.

questions.question: Why should studies linking diabetes medicines to COVID-19 outcomes be interpreted with caution?
questions.note: Results: indication bias and residual confounding in observational studies.

questions.question: Which diabetes medicines should be preferred as first-line treatment, according to the review of COVID-19 observational studies?
questions.note: Conclusion: metformin, SGLT-2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists.

questions.question: Which kinds of plant compounds in Eucommia may affect metabolism?
questions.note: Conclusion: iridoids, phenolic acids, flavonoids, lignans and polysaccharides.

questions.question: What kinds of treatments dominate the published randomised trials for age-related muscle loss?
questions.note: Abstract/discussion: nutritional, vitamin D, exercise and multicomponent interventions; standalone drug trials uncommon.

questions.question: Is the extra polycythaemia diagnosis seen with SGLT2 inhibitors confirmed by JAK2 testing?
questions.note: Discussion: more D45 codes but no higher detection of JAK2-positive PV (answer is no).

questions.question: How well did AI chatbots spot missed kidney-protecting medicines in made-up patient cases?
questions.note: Results/discussion: near-ceiling on SGLT2 inhibitor and finerenone omissions; divergence at an eGFR < 15 RASi rule.

questions.question: How consistent were AI models' answers when the same kidney case was asked several times?
questions.note: Discussion: 60%-89% full agreement across identical replicate queries. Targets the passage-level miss seen in set 1 (q13).

questions.question: How much lower was 30-day readmission when heart failure patients received nurse-coordinated care after discharge?
questions.note: Discussion: 15.8% vs 27.2%, odds ratio 0.50.

questions.question: Is low potassium on admission linked to dying in hospital among heart failure patients?
questions.note: Conclusion: no statistically significant association for hypokalemia (answer is no clear link).

questions.question: How many studies of treatments given after a head injury reported dementia as an outcome?
questions.note: Discussion: only two studies reported dementia outcomes.

questions.question: Is psychosis in Alzheimer's disease linked to faster biological ageing in men?
questions.note: Discussion: association found only in female APOE4 carriers, not in men.

questions.question: Which muscle measures declined fastest over three years in older people with type 2 diabetes?
questions.note: Discussion: handgrip and leg extension strength declined faster than muscle mass index.

questions.question: Why can brain tissue stay short of blood after a stroke even when the blocked artery has been reopened?
questions.note: Review abstract: recanalization does not guarantee tissue-level perfusion; neurovascular unit injury.

questions.question: What treatment approaches are being explored for childhood brain tumours driven by histone changes?
questions.note: Review abstract: tailored precision epigenetic therapy; past and current clinical trials.

questions.question: How does inflammation spread between the heart, kidneys and lungs?
questions.note: Conclusion: the heart-kidney-lung axis as one inter-organ inflammatory network.

questions.question: What do the stored studies say about metformin and heart disease?
questions.note: Multi-article: lower cardiovascular events in SCOPE; genetic proxy for metformin lowers coronary artery disease risk. PMC13121069 recommends metformin first-line but not for heart outcomes.

questions.question: Do GLP-1 based drugs protect the kidneys?
questions.note: Results: GLP1R genetic proxy protective against chronic kidney disease (OR 0.87). Check whether any other article counts.

questions.question: What do these studies report about memory and thinking problems in older adults?
questions.note: Multi-article: metformin and MMSE; interventions after brain injury and cognitive decline; psychosis in MCI and Alzheimer's.

questions.question: What limitations do observational studies of diabetes drugs share?
questions.note: Multi-article: confounding and indication bias, baseline differences, hypothesis-generating findings, residual confounding.

questions.question: Does prediabetes raise the risk of heart disease?
questions.note: Library paper without stored text.

questions.question: Do GLP-1 receptor agonists improve long-term outcomes in people with peripheral artery disease?
questions.note: Library paper without stored text; PMC13280743 reports peripheral artery disease only for metformin.

questions.question: Which individual SGLT2 inhibitor works best for heart outcomes?
questions.note: Library paper without stored text; stored articles treat SGLT2 inhibitors as one class.

questions.question: Do second-line diabetes tablets differ in their risk of atrial fibrillation?
questions.note: Library paper without stored text; PMC13280743 has genetic atrial fibrillation results for some drug targets, which may tempt an answer.

questions.question: What is the best treatment for an asthma attack in a child?
questions.note: Off-topic.

questions.question: Does daily flossing prevent gum disease?
questions.note: Off-topic.

questions.question: Is cognitive behavioural therapy effective for insomnia?
questions.note: Off-topic.
